In the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}, on the island of Svargrond, there are two hidden boxes, each with a {item:Mastermind Potion}. Follow the two paths through the mines, full of {wiki:Voodoo Cultists|voodoo cultists} and golems, to pick up the two potions, some gold and fish.
Stairs to the Formorgar Mines (west of Svargrond)
Access to the Formorgar Mines: you get it by accepting mission 9 of the {wiki:Ice Islands Quest|Ice Islands Quest}.
The {spell:Levitate} spell, to go up (and later down) on the way from Svargrond to the mines.
Enough health/mana potions for both routes
The mines are full of all kinds of {wiki:Voodoo Cultists|Voodoo Cultists}. Go prepared to fight on several fronts.
The two chests are on different routes that both start at the mine entrance: keep the maps open while you walk.

If you are not in **Svargrond** yet, take a boat there (for example in Carlin or with {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais): talk to the port captain and say {key:hi}, {key:svargrond}, {key:yes}. You arrive at {npc:Captain Breezelda}'s boat, in the **east** part of the city.
In the city of **Svargrond**, go **west**, use {spell:Levitate} to go up and follow the path towards the {wiki:Formorgar Mines}, as on the map.
Path from Svargrond to the Formorgar Mines

At the end of the path, go down the stairs to enter the {wiki:Formorgar Mines|Formorgar Mines}, beneath the {wiki:Formorgar Glacier}. You can only enter if you have already reached the "Formorgar Mines 1" mission of the {wiki:Ice Islands Quest|Ice Islands Quest}.
From the entrance, follow the path marked on the map.
Path to the first Mastermind Potion
On the 3rd floor (marked on the map with a small square) a {creature:Nightmare} may appear, sometimes brought in by other players.
Opening the box by the wall
At the end of the path, the reward is in a box **next to the wall**.
Going back to the entrance and following the second path
Go back to the mine entrance and follow the second path marked on the map.
Path to the second Mastermind Potion
Opening the box by the campfire
The reward is in a box **next to the fire**.

To leave, go back the same way to the entrance: return to the stairs you came down and climb them. Then follow the map path in reverse back to **Svargrond**, using {spell:Levitate} again (downwards this time) at the spot where you went up. In Svargrond, {npc:Captain Breezelda} takes you back by boat.
Follow this path in reverse to return to Svargrond
Besides the two {item:Mastermind Potion|Mastermind Potions}, the boxes also give 78 gp, 123 gp, 1 {item:Green Perch} and 2 {item:Rainbow Trout|Rainbow Trouts}.
